verdict.rationale: Asana runs its own App Directory at asana.com/apps. It lists dozens of first- and third-party integrations across categories: Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Figma, Notion, Salesforce, Stripe and others. It also lists automation hubs such as Zapier, n8n and Pipedream that extend connectivity to more tools. Missing for 10: no evidence of the actual size of the directory (the 'thousands' scale), no documentation of how a PM browses or installs apps from it, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace

citations.quote: Many apps in our App Directory create Asana tasks and kick start workflow from other tools.
